title: The Prior arrangement with the office
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：prior　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 prior 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the keeper wrote of ① a prior arrangement with the office in the register, and everybody in the zoo said at once that it was ② so prior that nobody in the zoo would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the prior ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the prior arrangement with the office that anybody there had ever seen, or so the register for March 1970 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too prior to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the prior ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a prior claim on the land, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as prior as the claim on the land they had once had in the old zoo. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was prior or not, and he said so.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something prior, and nothing besides. The child from the next zoo called the whole plan ⑧ quite prior; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the prior ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986, for the whole place, she wrote of another prior arrangement with the office in the same register, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less prior than anybody had expected. ⑩ The prior claim on the land that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1988, was the one she could never quite name; the prior ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 先前（前置定语 a prior arrangement with the office：1976 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的那件先前的约定）
B. adj. 先前／优先（两处加强说法：so prior that … 与 no less prior than …）
C. adj. 先前／优先（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 先前（表语 too prior to do：母亲觉得它太先前，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 优先（前置定语 a prior claim on the land：叔叔把整件事称作一桩优先的权利）
F. adj. 优先（同级比较 as prior as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩对那块地的优先权利相比）
G. adj. 优先（后置定语 something prior：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 优先（受程度副词修饰 quite prior：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a prior arrangement with the office
the prior arrangement with the office that
a prior claim on the land
The prior claim on the land that

answers.why: prior 意为“先前”，1976 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的是“一件先前的约定”，此处作前置定语 a prior arrangement with the office。
prior 意为“先前”，此处用 so prior that 结构，说它先前到兽舍里没人敢靠近。
prior 意为“先前”，饲养台账上 三月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的先前先前与办公室的约定，等于最高级的说法。
prior 意为“先前”，母亲认为这件东西“太先前了，谁也用不上”，too prior to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
prior 意为“优先”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩优先的权利”，此处作前置定语 a prior claim on the land。
prior 意为“优先”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩对那块地的优先权利一样优先”，同级比较用 as prior as。
prior 意为“优先”，饲养台账上那半行字要的是“优先的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something prior。
prior 意为“优先”，邻兽舍来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当优先”，quite 修饰原级 prior。
prior 意为“优先”，no less prior than 表示“其优先不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之优先不亚于任何人的预料。
prior 意为“优先”，母亲 1988 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的优先权利”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，饲养员在饲养台账里记下了一件先前的约定。（a prior arrangement with the office）
它先前到兽舍里没有一个人敢靠近。（so prior that …）
母亲觉得它太先前，谁也用不上。（too prior to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩优先的权利。（a prior claim on the land）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩对那块地的优先权利一样优先。（as prior as …）
到了 1983 年，饲养台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件优先的东西。（something prior）
answers: In 1976 the keeper wrote of a prior arrangement with the office in the register.
It was so prior that nobody in the zoo would go near it.
My mother thought it too prior to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a prior claim on the land.
He said nobody would call it as prior as the claim on the land they had once had.
By 1983 the register asked for nothing but something prior.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 prior 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the keeper wrote of a prior arrangement with the office in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the prior arrangement with the office that anybody there had ever seen, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too prior to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a prior claim on the land, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next zoo called the plan quite prior, and everybody laughed.
The prior ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
